title: Levy to fund dedicated Washington County Law Enforcement Services
ballot_label: Levy to fund dedicated Washington County Law Enforcement Services
summary: The City of Banks asks voters to approve a local option property tax levy to fund dedicated law enforcement services from Washington County. The levy rate, term and estimated revenue are in the official ballot title, which could not be read in machine-readable form during collection.
yes_means: A yes vote approves the City of Banks levy to fund dedicated Washington County law enforcement services, as described in the ballot caption.
no_means: A no vote rejects the City of Banks levy to fund dedicated Washington County law enforcement services.
gaps: No YES arguments collected: the county voters' pamphlet measure page (WC-55) could not be read, and no attributed supporting statement for the 2026 measure was found.
No NO arguments collected: the pamphlet measure page could not be read, and no attributed opposition statement was found.
Ballot question, summary, levy rate, term and explanatory statement not collected: the county ballot-title PDF is a scanned image and no City of Banks web page for the measure was found.

ballot_label_verification.note: Caption matches the county measure document title; the question and summary could not be read because the PDF is a scan.

summary_verification.note: Accurate as far as it goes. COMPLETENESS: Your Oregon News (Nick LaMora, 2026-09-26) reports that 34-352 renews the city's five-year levy at an unchanged $2.50 per $1,000, funding two contracted Washington County Sheriff's deputies for 80 hours a week. The summary could be completed from that source in a re-collection.

verification_summary.balance_notes: 0 YES / 0 NO; both gaps are documented. The pamphlet gives the measure one page (WC-55), so it probably holds only the ballot title and explanatory statement, with no or few filed arguments (unverified). The spot search found Your Oregon News 2026-09-26, which quotes City Manager Jolynn Becker on what happens if the levy fails but names no supporter or opponent argument. The collector's gap 'no City of Banks web page found' stands, but the T3 article was missed.
